records.name: Philadelphia Guild of Handweavers
records.summary: A fiber arts guild with a guild house in Manayunk, where weavers, quilters, sewers and other fiber makers gather to learn from each other.
records.what_you_do: Attend the monthly meeting at the guild house, or join a special interest group where members help each other build fiber skills.

schedule.text: Monthly meetings, typically on the second Thursday at 7 pm at the guild house

records.notes: Own site does not say whether meetings are open to non-members, so audience.open_to is set to members as the cautious reading; confirm through the contact form at https://pghw.org/contact/ before relying on it. Status is probably_active because the site is live but shows no dated item; with no dated item there is no last_sign_of_life, which DATA_MODEL ties to status unknown, so the importer may hold this record. Email is hidden behind the site's email protection, so it is left null. Cost is not stated. An older listing says first Thursday; the current site says second Thursday, which is used here.

records.name: Orchestra Society of Philadelphia
records.summary: A community orchestra founded in 1964 for experienced players who read music at sight. It plays through big orchestral works and does not give public concerts.
records.what_you_do: Each rehearsal covers one full program in one evening: the first half works through the hard sections, and the second half plays the piece with few stops.

schedule.text: Friday evening rehearsals, 7:30 to 10 pm, one program at a time

locations.label: Presser Hall, Room 240, Esther Boyer College of Music, Temple University

access.notes: The rehearsal room is on the second floor and reached by elevator, per the group's page.

records.notes: No orchestra tag exists in the vocabulary, so community_band is the closest match; please review. The page says strings can walk in any time, while winds and brass should contact the group first. The page does not mention auditions, but it describes the group as built for players who read well. No cost is stated. The page lists a Facebook group and an Instagram account without URLs, so neither is recorded. The dated evidence is the next listed rehearsal, October 9, 2026, with Verdi's Rigoletto.

records.name: Penn Staff & Community Choir
records.summary: A choir for adults 21 and older who work at Penn or live in Philadelphia, open to singers at every level. It meets on Tuesday evenings and gives a winter concert and a spring concert.
records.what_you_do: Join the weekly Tuesday evening rehearsals and sing in the choir's concerts alongside other Penn staff and Philadelphia neighbors.

schedule.text: Weekly rehearsals on Tuesday evenings, run in seasons (fall and winter, then spring)

records.notes: Full-time students are not eligible, per the choir page. The Penn Today item is dated January 29, 2025 and says no auditions are needed; the choir page does not say. Rehearsal room and time are not published, so no rehearsal location is recorded (the February 3, 2026 concert was at Philadelphia Episcopal Cathedral, 19 S. 38th Street). No cost is stated. Sign-ups for fall and winter have closed; the page says the membership form may still be sent for the spring season, with no deadline given. Membership form URL, not submitted: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/Kv4aWJkegf. Run by Penn's Office of Social Equity and Community.

records.name: Encore Chorale of Philadelphia
records.summary: A non-audition choir for older adults, run by the Encore Creativity program, that sings in four-part harmony with a professional conductor.
records.what_you_do: Sing at the Tuesday afternoon rehearsals and take part in the program's concerts, which are free and open to the public.

schedule.text: Tuesday afternoon rehearsals, 1 to 2:30 pm, during the fall and spring sessions

records.notes: The group page shows no session dates and no upcoming events; the Fall 2026 listing comes from the ensembles page. The 55 and older age limit, the four-part singing and the professional conductor are the organization's own statements on its ensembles page, not the chorale page. An older 2024 listing (seen in search only, not fetched) named Trinity Memorial Church on Spruce Street; the current group page names First Presbyterian Church, which is used. No cost is shown for this chorale. The site's register link (encorecreativity.org/register) was not used.

notes: Budget: all 8 WebSearch calls spent, one per topic, so community choir and orchestra coverage is thin and the city-wide sweep is incomplete. 37 WebFetch calls. Verdicts: 4 publish (Philadelphia Guild of Handweavers, Orchestra Society of Philadelphia, Penn Staff & Community Choir, Encore Chorale of Philadelphia); no hide, duplicate, not_a_group or out_of_area records written. Suburban groups seen only in search snippets were not written as records and are out of city: Valley Forge Chorus (Sweet Adelines, Malvern or Villanova), Vintage Harmony (Bensalem, 2020 listing), North Pennsmen (northern and western suburbs), Keystone Capital Chorus (Camp Hill), Pine Barons Chorus (South Jersey), Brothers in Harmony (Hamilton Square, NJ), Rose Tree Harmony Singers (Media, Delaware County), Liberty Belles (Lansdale), West Chester Area Community Chorus (Chester County), Bucks County Women's Chorus (Holland, PA), Cinnaminson Community Chorus (NJ), and a Delaware Urban Sketchers chapter (2017 news item). National finders: Barbershop Harmony Society finder blocked, so no Philadelphia chorus confirmed; Sweet Adelines chorus finder not found on singunited.org (the former sweetadelines.com redirects there); Urban Sketchers has no Philadelphia chapter in readable text and philadelphia.urbansketchers.org does not resolve; NMRA finder by ZIP only, no Philadelphia meeting place found; sca.org is 403, so the Barony of Bhakail is only partly checked; Embroiderers' Guild has a Philadelphia Area Chapter in Devon (Chester County), unverified; Handweavers Guild of America not checked. Not recorded: a Black Pearl Chamber Orchestra side-by-side program (2013 listing, no URL captured). Two data format points for the importer: (1) PGHW is probably_active with no last_sign_of_life because it has no dated item, which DATA_MODEL ties to status unknown; (2) no orchestra tag exists in the vocabulary, so the orchestra uses community_band. Also the Barony of Bhakail's Wiki-based details seen in a search snippet came from a different kingdom's wiki and were not used. Next steps for the owner: retry gpchorale.com, phillyexpress.org and the Bhakail site; ask the Philadelphia Guild of Handweavers whether meetings are open to visitors; look for a Philadelphia Urban Sketchers presence on social media; search again for the Sweet Adelines and barbershop city choruses if budget allows.
